controls.label: Visible color
controls.notes: Hubble visible-color map from 27 June 2019 with Juno-derived polar cloud structure and transferred visible color. Polar sources are not registered to the Hubble longitudes. This multi-source illustration does not depict one observation date or a geodetic polar map.

controls.label: Ultraviolet
controls.notes: Hubble OPAL at 275 nm (F275W), 11 December 2025, shown in false color. Gray grid marks unavailable coverage; polar-connected zero fill is masked before interpolation. Dark interior samples are retained. No Juno imagery supplies spectral detail.

controls.label: Methane
controls.notes: Hubble OPAL at 889 nm (FQ889N), 11 December 2025, shown in false color. Gray grid marks unavailable coverage; polar-connected zero fill is masked before interpolation. Dark interior samples are retained. No Juno imagery supplies spectral detail.

charts.title: Jupiter modeled disk reflectance
charts.description: Full 253-point NASA PSG modeled reflectance spectrum from 350 to 1000 nanometers. The wavelength band marks ultraviolet, visible light, and near-infrared regions.

metadata.model: Jupiter atmosphere, Moses et al. 2005, NASA PSG

charts.title: Jupiter temperature and pressure profile
charts.description: NASA PSG Jupiter vertical atmosphere model with 50 layers. Pressure runs from 10 bar to 10 nanobar on a logarithmic scale.

metadata.atmosphere: Jupiter atmosphere, Moses et al. 2005, JGR

charts.title: Jupiter photometric phase curve
charts.description: V-band dimming of Jupiter as phase angle increases from zero to 130 degrees.

source.title: Computing Apparent Planetary Magnitudes for The Astronomical Almanac
source.qualification: V-band phase equations transcribed from equations 2 through 17. Distance, rotation, season, latitude, and ring terms cancel or are held fixed so each curve isolates phase-angle dependence.

metadata.qualification: The greater-than-12-degree Cassini branch is limited to 130 degrees because the source paper reports no constraining data beyond that angle.
metadata.measurement: V-band magnitude change relative to zero-degree phase
